rt.text:
Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API ✨

With Tool Retrieval, you can scale to hundreds of tools without context bloat. Load parameter schemas on demand to preserve selection accuracy, cut tokens, and keep your prefix cache intact.

Read the blog: https://goo.gle/4ALQwgM https://t.co/Dths6RxWaD

author: Google
